steps.text: Installer runs unattended with the recipe's language and path arguments; the client then opens its login window, which renders fully (verified 2026-08-25 on engine sikarugir-10.0_6, the one CEF launcher that paints on this engine). Log in and game installs not yet exercised. The installer is a GUI (no silent mode): pick the install path and let it download the client. Battle.net's login is CEF-based like Steam's — keep sync: none. Historically the top-1 Whisky issue (54 comments); expect login flakiness.

knownIssues.cause: CEF under Wine; historically broken on CrossOver-derived engines too
knownIssues.fix: retry; keep sync none; disable hardware acceleration in Battle.net settings once in
